name: nbg-unity
description: Unity toolkit for NBG projects: MCP tool skills, studio coding standard, reward-package workflows.

plugins.name: unity-mcp
plugins.description: Feeder MCP tool skills for driving the Unity Editor: scene, gameobject, assets, prefab, script, screenshot, profiler, ui-inspect. Portable to any Unity project wired to the MCP bridge.

plugins.name: unity-standard
plugins.description: The portable Unity standard, applied automatically in any Unity project: C# and UI conventions, mockup-to-prefab pipeline, recompile and play-mode verification, package docs and git discipline.

plugins.name: reward-system
plugins.description: Reward-package deltas on top of unity-standard: the package contract, the package/demo-host boundary, repo UI facts, play-mode levers, Vietnamese docs, git release.
